subject: Access onboarding: SSO attribute mapping, SCIM delta plan & IP allowlist gate
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@widgetworks.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: IT Operations <it-ops@widgetworks.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff / SSO & SCIM for Redwood rollout

Hey Jordan,

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. We dug into the SSO attributes and have a couple clarifying asks before we hand off to our IdP team: two custom claims we want mapped (employeeType + costCenter), and we need confirmation on group sync cadence for SCIM (near-real-time vs nightly). Also attaching an export of our current attribute mappings (widgetworks_sso_attributes.csv).

Two immediate questions:
- Can Redwood accept non-standard claim names and map them to internal attributes during SAML?
- For SCIM, does Redwood expose a delta-only endpoint or will we need full-bulk sync?

Appreciate a quick note — our IdP vendor needs a target by EOD Monday so we can schedule the change window.

Best,
Alex
IT Ops, WidgetWorks
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@widgetworks.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff / SSO & SCIM for Redwood rollout

Alex — thanks, got the file. Short answers up front: yes on custom claim mapping (we support claim aliasing in the console) and we offer both full and delta SCIM flows; delta is preferred for lower churn and we can provide webhook-based notification to your platform team.

I want to loop in Marissa (CSM) and Ben (Security Eng) to propose a minimal gate plan so we stay compliant with your infosec controls before cutover. I27ll follow with a short mutual action plan and a SCIM delta template.

Jordan
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 16:25:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff / SSO & SCIM for Redwood rollout

Folks — forwarding Alex27s ask. Key items to confirm for WidgetWorks gate:
1) SAML attribute aliasing: confirm config UX and whether we can auto-provision two aliases (employeeType -> role, costCenter -> billingCenter).
2) SCIM cadence: recommend delta sync + webhook events. Need to provide scim_delta_template.json to their IdP team.
3) IP allowlist: WidgetWorks wants a locked-down egress path. We need their production IP CIDR list and to confirm whether we should add a temporary maintenance window to allow initial API pulls.
4) Service accounts: they want scoped service accounts for provisioning + telemetry. Need to decide RBAC roles and token TTL.

Proposed next steps (short):
- Ben: verify that claim aliasing meets our audit logging/traceability needs and confirm any additional header encryption requirements (owner: Ben, ETA Tue 6/8).
- Marissa: prepare Mutual Action Plan doc and run it past WidgetWorks; include cutover checklist, rollback criteria, and test cases (owner: Marissa, ETA Mon 6/7).
- Monica: capture required artifacts for SOC/infosec (KMS proof points, audit log sampling) to attach to the compliance packet.

I27ll attach the SCIM template and the IP allowlist spreadsheet to the follow-up.

—Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@widgetworks.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff / SSO & SCIM for Redwood rollout — Mutual action plan draft

Alex / Team — attaching the MAP draft and the SCIM delta template (see link). High level timeline and asks:

- Pickup window: Wed 6/16 00:00–04:00 PT for IdP config (we prefer low-traffic window).
- Pre-cutover checklist (items we need from WidgetWorks):
  * Finalized attribute mapping CSV (we got your draft; please confirm aliases inline).
  * Production SCIM endpoint and credentials for a read-only sync account.
  * Production CIDR block(s) for IP allowlist (we27ll add these and request one maintenance exception for initial provisioning).
  * Service account naming convention and requested scopes (provisioning vs telemetry).

Ben noted one security constraint: for service accounts that can create users we need a privileged token TTL of 60 mins and audit webhook enabled. Ben, please add any additional hard requirements to the MAP.

Alex, can you confirm those items by Tue 6/8 EOD? If that works we27ll lock the configuration window and send a DocuSign for the maintenance exception.

Thanks — Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: widgetworks-MAP-v1.pdf, scim_delta_template.json
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@widgetworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: IT Operations <it-ops@widgetworks.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff / SSO & SCIM for Redwood rollout — Mutual action plan draft

Marissa — thanks, that timeline works. Quick confirmations:
- We will provide the finalized attribute mapping (CSV) by Tue 6/8 EOD.
- SCIM: our platform supports delta feed; we will stand up a provisioning account with read/write limited to the /Users endpoint for the test window.
- IP allowlist: attaching production CIDRs in a follow-up (will send ip-allowlist-template.xlsx).
- Service accounts: agreed on naming convention; we27ll accept 60-min TTL for privileged ops tokens.

Go ahead and schedule the maintenance exception. We27ll expect a pre-cutover test plan and rollback steps in the MAP.

—Alex
